description: This file defines the 'Reminders' class for managing reminder objects, including methods for adding, retrieving, filtering, and formatting reminders. It also includes utility functions for handling reminder times and states within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Reminders
classes.description: Class for managing reminder objects, including CRUD operations and filtering.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a reminder in the collection.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a filter for all non-deleted reminders.

methods.name: active
methods.description: Returns a filter for active reminders.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a reminder exists by ID.
